text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 19 · 梦幻3D · 黑莓丝绒公主冬园 · 黑莓紫 / 玫瑰金 / 象牙白.
Environment: Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. High-end stylized 3D fairytale conservatory environment, sculpted ivory arches, blackberry-purple velvet curved seats, rose-gold botanical trellises, crystal-clear greenhouse roof and pale blossoms, polished but tactile velvet and frosted glass, gentle cinematic bounce light, richly elegant palette, no statues or human imagery.
Visual medium: dreamy 3d; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 4 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 19 · 梦幻3D · 黑莓丝绒公主冬园 · 黑莓紫 / 玫瑰金 / 象牙白. A 2x2 sheet of FOUR distinct eye-level camera views of the SAME ONE space: original forward direction, a lateral oblique view, a reverse view 180 degrees opposite, and the other lateral view. Labels A B C D only. Preserve ALL door/window/furniture positions; actually move camera, never mirror the building. Same material and lighting. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions. IMPORTANT: Reference 2 ORIGINAL image determines artistic medium and color grading: layered paper sculpture, Chinese ink watercolor, retro travel poster, vintage film or dreamy 3D, as applicable. Reference 1 only determines spatial layout. Preserve original palette and artistic medium. No dimension values or scale bars.
